meta.title: F1 到底在看什么？—— 车、赛、钱、人
meta.title_en: What Are You Actually Watching in F1? — Cars, Racing, Money, and People

scenes.title_cn: 开场：F1 为什么这么火
scenes.title_en: Opening: Why Is F1 So Big?
scenes.context: F1越来越火，中国大奖赛现场观众23万人次，规模上超过NBA，成为世界上最大的年度体育赛事。UP主做了大量调研、看纪录片、到现场，分「车、赛、钱、人」四部分讲F1到底在看什么。语域：科普口播，抛出问题。
sentences: 这个公认的赛车运动巅峰，到底有什么魔力？
What magic does this acknowledged pinnacle of motorsport actually hold?
the pinnacle of motorsport（赛车运动巅峰）；what magic（什么魔力）
现场观众有二十三万人次，甚至规模上超过了NBA。
The on-site audience reached 230,000 people — even surpassing the NBA in scale.
on-site audience（现场观众）；surpass the NBA（超过NBA）
我们分车、赛、钱、人四个部分来讲。
We'll break it down into four parts: the cars, the racing, the money, and the people.
break it down into（分成）；the cars, racing, money, and people（车赛钱人）
paraphrase: 赛车运动巅峰 → the pinnacle of motorsport / the top tier of racing
pinnacle · top tier
分成四部分 → break it down into four parts / organize it into four sections
break it down · four sections
scenes.speak: What magic does this acknowledged pinnacle of motorsport actually hold? The on-site audience reached 230,000 people — even surpassing the NBA in scale. We'll break it down into four parts: the cars, the racing, the money, and the people.

scenes.context: 一辆典型F1赛车造价1700万美元，1.6升V6引擎排量和本田飞度差不多，但有一千匹马力。重量800千克，零百2.4秒——看起来比超跑电车慢，因为F1是纯后驱，起步抓地力差，但100到200只要1.8秒。语域：科普讲解，数据密集。
sentences: 每辆造价在1700万美元左右，1.6升V6引擎，排量和本田飞度差不多。
Each car costs around 17 million dollars, with a 1.6-liter V6 engine — about the same displacement as a Honda Fit.
displacement（排量）；around 17 million dollars（1700万美元左右）
虽然只有一千匹马力，但100到200只要1.8秒。
Even with just a thousand horsepower, it does 100 to 200 km/h in only 1.8 seconds.
a thousand horsepower（一千匹马力）；only 1.8 seconds（只要1.8秒）
F1都是纯后驱车，起步的时候没什么抓地力。
F1 cars are pure rear-wheel drive, so they have little grip off the line.
rear-wheel drive（后驱）；little grip off the line（起步抓地力差）
paraphrase: 零百加速 → zero to a hundred / 0-100 km/h
zero to a hundred · 0-100
起步抓地力 → grip off the line / traction at launch
grip off the line · traction at launch
scenes.speak: Each car costs around 17 million dollars, with a 1.6-liter V6 engine — about the same displacement as a Honda Fit. Even with just a thousand horsepower, it does 100 to 200 km/h in only 1.8 seconds. F1 cars are pure rear-wheel drive, so they have little grip off the line.

scenes.context: F1那些浮夸的结构和线条都是为了提供下压力。F2战斗机飞行员形容F1赛车是「轮子上的飞机」——F1把机翼形状倒过来，车头车尾形成下压力，速度越快下压力越大，让车身牢牢吸在地面，高速过弯保持抓地力。语域：科普讲解，类比生动。
sentences: 曾经有一个F2战斗机飞行员这么形容F1赛车：轮子上的飞机。
A fighter pilot once described an F1 car as 'a plane on wheels.'
a plane on wheels（轮子上的飞机）
F1赛车把机翼的形状给倒了过来，这样车头车尾就形成了下压力。
F1 cars flip the wing shape upside down, creating downforce at the nose and tail.
flip the wing upside down（倒转机翼）；downforce（下压力）
速度越快下压力就越大，让车身被牢牢吸在地面。
The faster you go, the more downforce — pinning the car firmly to the track.
pinning the car to the track（把车吸在地面）
paraphrase: 轮子上的飞机 → a plane on wheels / an airplane glued to the road
plane on wheels · airplane on the road
被吸在地面 → pinned to the track / glued to the ground
pinned to the track · glued to the ground
scenes.speak: A fighter pilot once described an F1 car as 'a plane on wheels.' F1 cars flip the wing shape upside down, creating downforce at the nose and tail. The faster you go, the more downforce — pinning the car firmly to the track.

scenes.title_cn: 趣闻：倒着开与吸起井盖
scenes.title_en: Fun Facts: Driving Upside Down and a Sucked-Up Manhole
scenes.context: 两个趣闻：时速超过240公里时，F1的下压力会超过车身重量——如果有足够长的隧道，F1能倒着开在天花板上。2023年拉斯维加斯大奖赛，一辆法拉利经过老化井盖时直接把井盖吸起来了，结果砸了一辆车还被罚。语域：科普口播，趣闻叙事。
sentences: 在时速超过240公里的时候，F1赛车所产生的下压力就会超过车身重量。
Above 240 km/h, the downforce an F1 car generates exceeds its own weight.
exceed its own weight（超过车身重量）
如果有一个足够长的隧道，F1赛车就能倒着开在天花板上。
Given a tunnel long enough, an F1 car could drive upside down on the ceiling.
drive upside down（倒着开）；on the ceiling（在天花板上）
一辆法拉利直接把井盖吸起来了，靠的就是空气动力学形成的吸力。
A Ferrari literally sucked up a manhole cover, powered purely by aerodynamic suction.
suck up（吸起来）；a manhole cover（井盖）
paraphrase: 倒着开 → drive upside down / run on the ceiling
drive upside down · on the ceiling
空气动力学吸力 → aerodynamic suction / aero downforce vacuum
aerodynamic suction · downforce
scenes.speak: Above 240 km/h, the downforce an F1 car generates exceeds its own weight. Given a tunnel long enough, an F1 car could drive upside down on the ceiling. A Ferrari literally sucked up a manhole cover, powered purely by aerodynamic suction.

scenes.title_en: The Racing: Rules, Loopholes, and Evolution
scenes.context: 每家车队的车完全不同，冠军有两个——车队冠军和车手冠军。工程师在规则变化中绞尽脑汁钻空子：迈凯伦发明F-Duct，声称是散热孔，实则车手在直线上用左腿堵住孔，扰乱尾翼气流减阻，直线快5-10公里。第二年规则允许可动空气动力学组件，变成DRS。语域：科普讲解，叙事曲折。
sentences: 合规之外不控制变量，除了比车手还要比车。
Outside the rulebook nothing is standardized — teams compete on both driver and machinery.
not standardized（不控制变量）；compete on machinery（比车）
迈凯伦想到了一个妙招：在驾驶舱前方弄了一个小孔，也就是后来传奇的F-Duct。
McLaren came up with a trick: a small hole ahead of the cockpit, the legendary F-Duct.
came up with a trick（想到妙招）；the legendary F-Duct（传奇的F-Duct）
第二年规则就允许可动空气动力学组件了，就叫DRS阻力削减系统。
The next year, movable aero was legalized as DRS — the Drag Reduction System.
legalize（合法化）；Drag Reduction System（阻力削减系统）
paraphrase: 钻空子 → game the rules / exploit loopholes
game the rules · exploit loopholes
想到妙招 → come up with a trick / a clever workaround
a trick · a workaround
scenes.speak: Outside the rulebook nothing is standardized — teams compete on both driver and machinery. McLaren came up with a trick: a small hole ahead of the cockpit, the legendary F-Duct. The next year, movable aero was legalized as DRS — the Drag Reduction System.

scenes.title_en: The Racing: Strategy That Feels Like a Game
scenes.context: F1本质是时速300公里的即时策略游戏：DRS像游戏里的弹射加速，2026年被超车模式取代；轮胎设计的第一优先级是让比赛更好看，抓地力会出现断崖式下降，像游戏里的武器耐久度。21年开始引入预算帽，还有空气动力学测试时间的反向分配。语域：科普讲解，游戏类比。
sentences: F1比赛不是普通的开快车，而是时速300公里的即时策略游戏。
F1 isn't just driving fast — it's a real-time strategy game at 300 km/h.
a real-time strategy game（即时策略游戏）
轮胎的断崖式耐久度设计，让F1有了特别多的战术策略可以玩。
The cliff-edge tire degradation design opens up tons of strategic plays.
cliff-edge degradation（断崖式耐久度）；strategic plays（战术策略）
预算帽相当于给了所有人同样的金币上限，落后的人反而获得了更多的开发资源。
The budget cap gives everyone the same gold cap — and the teams behind actually get more development resources.
budget cap（预算帽）；development resources（开发资源）
paraphrase: 断崖式下降 → cliff-edge drop / falls off a cliff
cliff-edge · falls off a cliff
平衡性补丁 → balance patch / game-balancing tweaks
balance patch · balancing tweaks
scenes.speak: F1 isn't just driving fast — it's a real-time strategy game at 300 km/h. The cliff-edge tire degradation design opens up tons of strategic plays. The budget cap gives everyone the same gold cap — and the teams behind actually get more development resources.

scenes.title_en: The Money: From Losing Money to $4 Billion a Year
scenes.context: F1曾经是烧钱运动：红牛一年砸2.5亿欧元，就为了让logo绕圈跑。转折点是2017年Liberty Media花80亿美元买下F1商业运营权，把老派管理者的做法全反过来：做社交媒体、主动找Netflix拍《疾速争胜》、在美国搞三场大奖赛。年收入从15亿涨到近40亿美元，来源是转播权、赞助、举办费和现场款待。语域：科普讲解，商业叙事。
sentences: 红牛一年往车队里砸2.5亿欧元，就为了让一台车上印着自己的logo绕圈跑。
Red Bull pours 250 million euros a year into its team just to have its logo circle the track.
pour into（砸钱）；circle the track（绕圈跑）
Liberty Media花了80亿美元，买下了F1的商业运营权。
Liberty Media spent eight billion dollars to buy the commercial rights to F1.
commercial rights（商业运营权）
城市要给F1付举办费，给钱才能获得举办F1的尊贵资格。
Cities pay F1 a hosting fee — you pay to earn the privilege of hosting a Grand Prix.
a hosting fee（举办费）；the privilege of hosting（举办资格）
paraphrase: 商业运营权 → commercial rights / the rights to run the business
commercial rights · run the business
举办费 → a hosting fee / the price of hosting
hosting fee · price of hosting
scenes.speak: Red Bull pours 250 million euros a year into its team just to have its logo circle the track. Liberty Media spent eight billion dollars to buy the commercial rights to F1. Cities pay F1 a hosting fee — you pay to earn the privilege of hosting a Grand Prix.

scenes.title_en: The People: Champions, Teammates, and the Documentary
scenes.context: F1吸引粉丝的本质是人：七冠王汉密尔顿、勒克莱尔、让大家以为荷兰国歌是F1主题曲的维斯塔潘。队友之间开一样的车，谁好谁差非常明显。推荐Netflix的《疾速争胜》，把F1拍成有人物故事的真人秀。UP主到现场的感受：F1经过时是用胸腔感受到的。语域：科普口播，感性收尾。
sentences: 只有你和你的队友开的是一样的车，谁开得好谁开得不好就非常明显了。
Only you and your teammate drive identical cars, so who's better is painfully obvious.
identical cars（一样的车）；painfully obvious（非常明显）
《疾速争胜》不讲技术战术，只讲人的挣扎和成长。
Drive to Survive doesn't cover tech or tactics — it's all about human struggle and growth.
human struggle（人的挣扎）；growth（成长）
F1赛车从旁边经过的时候，不是用眼睛看到的，而是用胸腔感受到的。
When an F1 car goes by, you don't see it with your eyes — you feel it in your chest.
feel it in your chest（用胸腔感受）
paraphrase: 队友暗斗 → teammate rivalry / friction between teammates
teammate rivalry · friction
用胸腔感受 → feel it in your chest / feel it in your bones
feel it in your chest · feel in your bones
scenes.speak: Only you and your teammate drive identical cars, so who's better is painfully obvious. Drive to Survive doesn't cover tech or tactics — it's all about human struggle and growth. When an F1 car goes by, you don't see it with your eyes — you feel it in your chest.

practice: 说 F1 是策略游戏
F1 isn't just driving fast — it's a real-time strategy game at 300 km/h.
The faster you go, the more downforce — pinning the car firmly to the track.
Red Bull pours 250 million euros a year into its team for a moving logo.
Drive to Survive covers no tech — it's all about human struggle and growth.
pitfalls: Each car costs around 17 million dollars.
中文「1700万」不要直译；英文用 17 million 或 $17M。
downforce（下压力）是一个专业合成词，写成一个单词；give 太口语，用 generate/produce。
F1 can drive upside-down on the tunnel top.
Given a tunnel long enough, an F1 car could drive upside down on the ceiling.
tunnel top 中式表达；用 on the ceiling 更自然，且「倒着开」用 drive upside down。
The city must pay money to F1.
Cities pay F1 a hosting fee.
pay money to 冗余；直接说 pay a hosting fee（付举办费）。
shifts: 用 a real-time strategy game（策略游戏）、go head-to-head（正面硬刚）、balance patch（平衡性补丁）
用 downforce（下压力）、grip off the line（起步抓地力）、pinned to the track（吸在地面）
用 pour 250M into（砸钱）、burn money（烧钱）、costs a fortune（贵得离谱）
footer_notes: ASR 专有名词已校正：F1→F1、FE→F1、SF24→SF-24、麦凯伦→迈凯伦、FDACT→F-Duct、DRS→DRS、Undercut→Undercut、Overcut→Overcut、Liberty Media→Liberty Media、伯尼·埃克莱斯顿→伯尼·埃克莱斯顿、Drive to Survive→《疾速争胜》、Netflix→Netflix、汉密尔顿→汉密尔顿、勒克莱尔→勒克莱尔、维斯塔潘→维斯塔潘、霍肯伯格→霍肯伯格、伯托莱托→博托莱托、赛娜→塞纳、Sauber→索伯、NEO ES9→蔚来ES8、奥迪→奥迪、CDL→凯迪拉克、Pedex→Paddock、汉达伊→现代、奇摩→等等，不再一一列举。
